_comment: Path-level server template applied by provider-dev/scripts/post_process.mjs to every Domains v2 customer-scoped operation (paths under /v2/customers/{customerId}/...). The customer_id server variable is resolved from GODADDY_CUSTOMER_ID (x-stackQL-envVar) when set; otherwise it is a required parameter on those methods. A WHERE customer_id value always wins over the environment.

customer_id.description: GoDaddy customer identifier (UUID, not the numeric shopper number). Resolved from the GODADDY_CUSTOMER_ID environment variable when it is set (x-stackQL-envVar); otherwise it must be supplied on every query as WHERE customer_id = '<uuid>'. A WHERE value always takes precedence over the environment. API resellers acting on behalf of a subaccount pass the subaccount customer identifier.
